items.description: The Al Hamra Tower is the tallest building in Kuwait and a prominent example of modern sculptural architecture. Its unique twisting design serves to minimize solar heat gain.
The Grand Mosque is the largest mosque in Kuwait, renowned for its intricate Islamic architectural details and large central dome. It serves as a spiritual landmark for the capital city.
The Sheikh Jaber Al-Ahmad Cultural Centre is a major multidisciplinary arts complex inspired by Islamic architecture. It hosts theaters, concert halls, and exhibition spaces.
facts: Known as the Kuwait Opera House

items.description: The Sheikh Abdullah Al-Salem Cultural Centre is one of the world's largest cultural museum complexes, featuring diverse exhibitions on science, history, and fine arts.
The Avenues is the largest shopping mall in Kuwait, featuring a massive indoor space divided into distinct districts with various architectural themes.
The Scientific Center of Kuwait combines science education, environmental awareness, and entertainment, including a large aquarium and a cinema.
Green Island is an artificial island off the coast of Kuwait, offering recreational activities, gardens, and seaside promenades.
The Sheikh Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah Causeway is a massive bridge project connecting Kuwait City to the northern Subiya region.
Mall 360 is a prominent shopping and leisure destination in Kuwait, noted for its circular design and high-end retail options.
